## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `45ed0a4bf5cf79a76f4ea24655c5488b8d64f0db` · 2026-11-26T01:02Z

PR #37380 for card #37360, ruling A (comment 7177310364, the maintainer's words 「37360 同意」). Read against GitHub and the tree at the head, not against the dev report (comment 7178891404).

### Findings

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- Landing: Tier H. `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 37380`, run from a tree at `origin/main`, reads `landing tier: H(人合)` on `docs/adr/**` ×1 (`docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md`), and its low-risk arm reads Tier H as well (twelve paths outside skills wording, and the changeset releases two `@object-ui` packages). 536 changed lines (+509 / −27), under the 3000-line threshold. No seat flips the PR ready, enqueues it or arms auto-merge: it stays a draft and waits for the maintainer's merge or an authorized approval. K = 2 (`landing-k.mjs --pr 37380`, exit 0: PRBASE `b8c8c8897c`, hold at 15, no new locale pack, no shared book moved).

N1 — The order "held types first, then the not-held ones, inside each group" is in the code and is not pinned. Ablation of mine: `[...scopedEntries, ...notHeldEntries]` reversed in `DirectoryPage.tsx` leaves `DirectoryPage.allTypes-37360.test.tsx` and `metadataAreaHost.scope-28561.test.tsx` green (2 files, 21 tests). The fixture has no group that mixes a held and a not-held type in an order that differs from served order. The ruling does not rule the order; the changeset states it. Suggested: a test-only follow-up (hold `object`, not `hook`, and expect `object` before `hook`), or accept as is.
N2 — On a read-only package with no customization pair (a kernel package), a not-held type whose word is "can be customized" carries the hover text "This package holds none yet: open the list to make the first", and that list offers no New (`ResourceListPage.tsx`: `canCreate` needs `!host.readOnly || createInPair`). The rewritten kernel case in `metadataAreaHost.scope-28561.test.tsx` shows exactly this tile (`flow`). Hover text only; the visible state word is the page's existing one, as the ruling asked; the menu's `engine.studio.menu.emptyType` (PR #37341) has the same looseness. The PR body's acceptance note "the list can still make a first item" on a read-only package holds only where the pair exists; that sentence can be corrected in the PR body without moving the head. Suggested: a follow-up card for the hover text on read-only packages.
N3 — The browser walk the card's plan asked for (a new empty package, ending with a first email template made from the screen) is NOT MEASURED, as the dev declared. What is measured: the real directory page and the real list page in jsdom, tile click to `/studio/PKG/metadata/email_template?package=PKG`, and `metadata-list-create` on that page. The create form and its save into the package are not exercised by this PR's tests. The PR's two-minute check gives the walk to whoever merges.
N4 — The ADR line and the changeset say the directory lists "every type of the six groups". Two exceptions in the code, both deliberate and pinned: `field` (hidden; the ADR's own "Not every type draws a row" already says it has no list) and a failed diagnostics sweep, which lists and marks nothing. Accepted imprecision.

### 1 · Shape

- `l1-face.mjs --pr 37380` at the head, read 2026-11-26T00:57Z: exit 0, every row `ok` — open, draft, base `main`; first line `Fixes #37360`; no closing keyword binds another card; no `content/docs/releases/` path; one non-empty changeset; `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`; `Skills-docs:` not owed; dogfood not owed.
- `Fixes` is right: the ruling's four parts (the row, the directory, a tile that opens a list with New, the dated ADR-0084 line) are all in this PR. The card planned the ADR line as a card of its own; the claim (7177496261) folded it into this PR's file surface.
- Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; three commits, each with the session trailer; `git diff --check` clean.

### 2 · Premise and behaviour, measured on the tree

- The fold's rule is unchanged. `studioMenuData.ts` still passes `always: STUDIO_MENU_ALWAYS_TYPES` to the shared `scopeDirectoryEntries`; `directoryScope.ts` and `buildStudioMenu`'s grouping are not in the diff; the new row is built by `studioMenuAllTypesEntry` outside `buildStudioMenu`. CONTROL pins: rendered (`email_template` and `position` served, held by none, absent from the open fold) and model-level.
- The row sits last, under no group: rendered after `renderGroups(tiers.advanced, 'advanced')` inside the fold region, in a plain `div` with no group and no group label; package scope only (`null` on `~org` and `~all`).
- The directory, on a package under Studio's area: the held types as before (count, no mark), then per group every other served type of the six groups, marked "None yet" / 「还没有」 with no count and the existing state word. The page waits for the sweep before it draws (`diagLoading`), so nothing is marked "None yet" before the sweep answers. Setup's directory and the `~all` leg are untouched (`onPackage` is false there).
- A not-held tile links to the type's list with `?package=`; the real list page renders New for a creatable type.
- The six types that cannot be created in Studio are listed, read-only, with the hover text "This package holds none, and none can be made here"; "Hide read-only" drops them (pinned). Reasonable use of the choice the ruling left open: the ruling's words are "every type of the six groups", and no second hand-kept list is needed.
- ADR-0084: +2 / −0 (one line and a blank), under "Entries that are not a type". It cites the card, the ruling comment and the verbatim words; its date is the ruling's calendar day (2026-11-25T23:14Z; the commit that wrote it is 2026-11-25T23:29Z). Each clause matches the code, with the N4 exceptions.
- Translation keys: `released-keys-removed.mjs --tag @object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` reads 77 at the head and 77 at the merge-base `d5ae7a47ac`, the same set (`diff` empty): this PR removes none. The i18n hunks carry no deleted line. `engine.studio.menu.allTypes`, `engine.directory.notHeld`, `engine.directory.notHeldTitle`, `engine.directory.notHeldReadOnlyTitle` each exist once in `studio/en.ts` and once in `studio/zh.ts` (the namespace has only those two catalogues).
- Declarations: `readClause2Line` and `readMetadataProtocolLine` (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`) read `declared` · `no` and `declared` · `none` on the card's newest `Claim:` comment (7177496261, the only one), on the PR body and on the changeset. They are right: no schema or metadata key changes; `@object-ui/app-shell` is private and its entry still exports `MetadataDirectoryPage` with no props; the studio catalogue is a `Record` of strings, so four added keys change no exported type. Precedent: PR #37341 added studio keys under the same two lines.

### 3 · Gates

- Check-runs at the head, read 2026-11-26T00:57Z: 59 runs — 48 `success`, 11 `skipped` (all on the expected-skip list per `l1-face`), 0 failed, 0 pending. Floor: `Lint & Repo Gates` success, `TypeScript Type Check` success. Also green: `Test Core`, `Test UI` and its 16 shards, `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`, `Check Changeset`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`.
- Polling, as seen: 2026-11-26T00:37Z 14 success / 30 pending; 2026-11-26T00:46Z 30 success / 17 in progress; 2026-11-26T00:48Z 38 / 9; 2026-11-26T00:52Z 7 pending, 0 non-green; 2026-11-26T00:56Z 0 pending, 0 non-green. The PR head did not move.
- Pins at the head, in a throwaway worktree (removed afterwards): the five pin files, `vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 90 passed (90) — the dev's numbers.
- Ablations, each one mutation with the anchor counted 1, the tree restored and clean after:

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| A · the row's render in the fold becomes `{null}` | red, 3 of 28: `Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="studio-menu-entry-allTypes"]` |
| B · `directoryNotHeldEntries` returns `[]` | red, 5 of 8: `expected [ 'hook', 'object' ] to deeply equal [ Array(5) ]` |
| C · a not-held tile links to `.` | red, 1 of 8: the tile's `href` assertion |
| D · the menu's `always` becomes every served type | red, 3 of 28: `expected … to be null` on `type:email_template` |
| F (mine) · the `!diagError` guard removed | red, 1 of 8: the failed-sweep control |
| G (mine) · the row drawn before the fold's groups | red, 1 of 28: the last-row assertion |
| H (mine) · no tile is told it is not held | red, 2 of 21: the mark, and the rewritten kernel case |
| I (mine) · the directory is no entry's page again | red, 3 of 69: the model pin, the rendered pin and the rewritten `StudioDesignSurface.metadataArea-28561` case |
| E (mine) · not-held before held | green, 21 of 21 — N1 |

### 4 · Accepted deviations

- Files beyond the claim's surface, each justified. `StudioPaletteGroups.tsx`: one icon row, required because `ENTRY_ICONS` is a `Record` over every entry kind (the palette draws only the menu's groups, so it shows nothing new). `StudioDesignSurface.metadataArea-28561.test.tsx`: "no link is current at the directory" became "the current link is `studio-menu-entry-allTypes`" — the ruling makes the directory an entry's page, and `getByRole` still fails on zero or on two current links, so nothing was lost. `metadataAreaHost.scope-28561.test.tsx`: the kernel package's directory read "No matches" and now lists `flow` as not held, with the href scoped to the kernel package and the URL unrepaired — the fixture has `flow` held by two other packages, so a scope leak would drop the mark or change the href; the old pin's intent is kept. Both rewrites are marked in place with what they read before.
- Construction tier (the seat's, not the diff's): `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` prints MANDATORY for `docs/adr/**`, with no one-line exit, and the claim reads `model: TIER_DEFAULT`, `effort: high`, with no exit reason. The compensating control is the at-tier contract review on this head. `execution-duties.md` also keeps `docs/adr/**` out of an implementation card's file surface; here the ruled line rides with its implementation.
- `overlap-check` was run by the dev once, on the final head. Re-read here: `git merge-tree` of the head is clean against `origin/main` `15a5be1d1e` (8 first-parent commits past the merge-base, no changed file in common) and against #37362 `178bfae911`, #37368 `6fbbdd9b30` (each shares only `studio/en.ts` and `studio/zh.ts`) and #37357 `baa9e0e0fb` (no shared file). Also clean against #37383 `2322b40282` (card #36909, named in the claim), which shares `studioMenuModel.ts` and `StudioDesignSurface.metadataArea-28561.test.tsx`: whichever lands second re-runs on the merged tree.
- A git-answerable read in the report: none seen.
- Outside the repository: the dev left `/build.pid` (5 bytes) at the container's filesystem root; it is still there and is not in the diff.

### 5 · Out of scope, and Skills-docs

- `Skills-docs:` not owed (`Metadata-protocol: none`, no narrowing arm). The report's `out_of_scope_findings` and `open_questions` are empty.
- The changeset, read sentence by sentence against the diff: "Studio's 高级 Advanced fold lists a type only when the package holds one, so a new app showed no way to make its first email template, document, book, field mapping, seed data or AI context pack." — true, the card's six. "The fold now ends with one row under no group, 全部类型 All types, which opens the type directory." — true. "On a package that page lists the types the package holds, as before, and after them in each group every other type of the menu's six groups, marked None yet (zh: 还没有) with the word that says what can be done there; a tile opens the type's list, whose New makes the first item." — true, with N1 (order unpinned) and N4. "Types that cannot be made in Studio are listed as read-only, and Hide read-only drops them." — true. "The fold's own rule is unchanged: a 高级 type appears in it once the package holds one. The directory is the row's current page." — true. "New locale keys in the studio catalogue (en, zh): … No props or entry exports change." — true.
- For the seat's ACCEPT lines: N1 and N2 are follow-up candidates; N3 is the maintainer's two-minute check or a seat dogfood walk; N4 is accepted. The card's own "seen on the way" (no New for `agent` and `picklist`) is not part of this PR.

### 6 · 维护者速读, as the dev drafted it

- Line 1 (what changes) and line 2 (why): accurate.
- Line 3 (what if it goes wrong): accurate; the final version should add that the browser walk on a new empty app was not measured (N3).
- Line 4 (what is asked): accurate — the ADR line makes the PR governed; the final version cites the PASS record's comment id and the Head-sha.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `45ed0a4bf5cf79a76f4ea24655c5488b8d64f0db`
Local-runs: probe — the seat ordered the L1 pin and ablation run on this same head in one throwaway worktree (five pin files, nine single-line mutations); the worktree is removed
Scope: docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md + ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioMenu.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioMenuModel.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/DirectoryPage.tsx
Security-touching: no

PR #37380, card #37360, ruling A (comment 7177310364, the maintainer's words 「37360 同意」). Inputs: the card body and its four comments, the PR body, the 14-file net diff against `main`, and the check-runs on the head. The rules face: `docs/adr/**`, one hit. The rest of the diff (tests, the palette icon row, the catalogues, the changeset) is the lane seat's ACCEPT.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set: unchanged — right. No schema, no metadata key, no registry flag is touched; which types can be created is read from the registry as it is.
- Public surface: unchanged — right. `@object-ui/app-shell` is private; its entry still exports `MetadataDirectoryPage`, which takes no props, and `index.ts` is not in the diff. `studioMenuAllTypesEntry`, `directoryNotHeldEntries` and the `allTypes` member of `StudioMenuEntryKind` are module exports the entry does not re-export.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: four keys added to the studio catalogue in `en` and `zh` (`engine.studio.menu.allTypes`, `engine.directory.notHeld`, `engine.directory.notHeldTitle`, `engine.directory.notHeldReadOnlyTitle`); the catalogue is a `Record` of strings, so no exported type changes. No released key is removed: `released-keys-removed.mjs` against `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` reads the same 77 at the head and at the merge-base `d5ae7a47ac`.
- `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` — right. `readClause2Line` and `readMetadataProtocolLine` read `declared` on the card's newest `Claim:` comment (7177496261), on the PR body and on the changeset, with the same values. Precedent: PR #37341 added studio keys under the same two lines.
- The fold's rule: unchanged — right. The row is built outside `buildStudioMenu`; `scopeDirectoryEntries` and the menu's `always` list are untouched.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/37360-studio-all-types.md`: `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`. The level follows `Metadata-protocol: none`: patch is right. The body carries both declaration lines. `Check Changeset` is `success` on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The report's `open_questions`: empty. `security_findings`: none. `out_of_scope_findings`: empty.
- Dev deviation, overlap read once: re-read here. `git merge-tree` of the head is clean against `origin/main` `15a5be1d1e` and against #37362, #37368, #37357 and #37383.
- Dev deviation, browser walk not measured: stands as N3 below. It does not bear on the ADR line.
- Dev deviation, a stray `/build.pid` at the container root: outside the repository and the diff.
- Files beyond the claim's surface (`StudioPaletteGroups.tsx`, two rewritten pin files): the lane seat's reading; none is a `hits` file or implements one.
- Construction tier: `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` prints MANDATORY for `docs/adr/**` and the claim reads `model: TIER_DEFAULT` with no exit reason. This record, rendered at the mandated tier by an agent other than the drafter, is the compensating control.
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; nothing written off the relay.
- SQL push-down: no finding. The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no join; the directory filters registry entries the page had already been served.

### ④ Design judgment

`docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md` — one added line (+2 / −0), under "Entries that are not a type". Judged against the ruling, against its first consumer (this PR's menu and directory) and against the rest of the record.

- "on a package the menu holds a fifth entry, 全部类型 All types" — holds. `studioMenuAllTypesEntry` answers an entry for the package scope and `null` for `~org` and `~all`.
- "the last row of the 高级 Advanced fold, below its groups — the one entry that sits under no group" — holds. `StudioMenu.tsx` draws it after `renderGroups(tiers.advanced, 'advanced')` inside the fold region, in no group and under no label. Pinned, and red when the row is removed or drawn before the groups.
- "It opens the type directory" — holds. Its target is the area's root, whose index route is the directory; `studioMenuCurrentKey` makes that page the row's.
- "which lists every type of the six groups: the ones the package holds, and the ones it holds none of yet, each marked so with what can be done there" — holds, with N4. `directoryNotHeldEntries` adds every served type whose `domain` is one of `STUDIO_MENU_GROUPS` and that the shared rule did not list; each carries the "None yet" mark and the page's existing state word.
- "The fold's rule stands — a 高级 type is drawn when the package holds one." — holds. Pinned by two controls; red when the menu's `always` list is widened.
- Against the ruling: the line names the entry and says it sits under no group, which is what the ruling asked of ADR-0084; it adds nothing the ruling did not say. It is dated the ruling's calendar day (2026-11-25T23:14Z) and cites the card, the ruling comment and the verbatim words.
- Against the record: add-only. The sentence above it still reads "four entries", and the amendment's "The four entries that are not a type are 高级 on a package. Each is drawn after the types of its group" still stands for those four; the new line is the dated exception for the fifth, in the record's own amend-in-place form. The earlier "Weighed and not taken: an entry of its own outside the six groups" was about four Access types a group already lists; the card weighed that sentence and the ruling took A with it in view.
- Execution plan: none is left open by the line; its only consumer ships in the same PR.

The implementing files agree with the line. Attempts to break it: a sweep still loading (the page draws nothing until it answers, so no type is marked early); a failed sweep (nothing listed or marked; pinned, red without the guard); `~org`, `~all` and Setup (no row, no added types; pinned); a menu search (the row is listed last when its name matches; pinned); a read-only package (N2); the hidden `field` and a type outside the six groups (never listed; pinned); the `datasource` tile (opens Setup's Datasources page, as the menu's row does).

No must-fix, no should-fix.

N1 — "held first, then not-held, inside each group" is in the code (`[...scopedEntries, ...notHeldEntries]`, then a stable grouping) and no test tells it from the reverse: that mutation leaves the two directory test files green (21 of 21). The ADR line does not state an order; the changeset does. A test-only follow-up, or accepted.
N2 — On a read-only package with no customization pair, a not-held type whose word is "can be customized" carries the hover text "open the list to make the first", and that list offers no New. Hover text only; the visible word is the page's existing one, which is what the ruling asked for. A follow-up card.
N3 — The browser walk on a new empty package is not measured; the create form and its save are not exercised by this PR's tests. The lane seat's to carry.
N4 — "every type of the six groups" has two deliberate exceptions the line does not name: the hidden `field`, which the record already says has no list, and a failed sweep. Accepted imprecision.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：Studio 左侧菜单「高级」折叠区的最后多了一行「全部类型」；点开是类型目录页，按六个分组列出全部类型：这个应用已有的类型照旧显示数量，还没有的标着「还没有」并写明在这里能不能新建；点某个类型进入它的列表，列表上有「新建」。「高级」里原有的行和规则没有变。
- 为什么做：按你在 #37360 的裁决（「37360 同意」，方案 A）；此前新建的应用里，邮件模板、文档、文档手册、字段映射、初始数据、AI 上下文包这几种类型在界面上没有入口，建不出第一条。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是目录页上某个类型的「还没有」标错，或点进去的列表不能新建；菜单其余部分不受影响，本改动可以整体撤回。从空应用一路走到建出第一个邮件模板，这一步没有在真实浏览器里实测，自动化测试只覆盖到「点开类型后列表页出现新建按钮」。
- 要你做什么：本改动给架构决策记录 ADR-0084 加了一句修订，属于需要你亲手批准或合并的改动；请批准或合并 PR #37380。契约审核通过的记录见 PR comment 7179389506，Head-sha `45ed0a4bf5cf79a76f4ea24655c5488b8d64f0db`。

Approval request at 2026-11-26T01:03Z. The seat's L1 reading is ACCEPT and the same-head contract review is PASS, both on head `45ed0a4bf5cf79a76f4ea24655c5488b8d64f0db`. Check-runs on that head, read 2026-11-26T00:57Z: 59 runs, 48 success, 11 expected skips, none failed, none pending. The head merges cleanly onto `origin/main` `15a5be1d1e`, and K = 2. The PR is Tier H because it adds one dated line to `docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md`, so the seat does not flip it ready, enqueue it or arm auto-merge; it stays a draft until an authorized approval or the maintainer's own merge. Four nits are recorded in the seat record, none blocking: the held-before-not-held order is not pinned by a test, one hover text is loose on a read-only package without a customization pair, the browser walk was not measured, and the ADR line's "every type" leaves the hidden `field` unnamed.
